title: Rekindle implementation research for Hacking Together A Discord Clone
method: Source, caller, UI consumer and documentation tracing. Source presence is not live end-to-end validation.
worktree_note: Existing local modification to docs/plans/video-media-engine.md was excluded from committed implementation evidence.

claims.finding_and_limit: Desktop embeds Veilid; daemon/CLI uses Noise-IK IPC. Do not imply complete feature parity.
Porters and waystations map to peer contributions and mutual aid. This historical plan needs code corroboration for individual mechanisms.
Readers collect authored entries, sort by Lamport and author, then validate permissions. Convergence assumes the same entry set.
Creator receives ALL permissions; roles govern other members. Separate distributed enforcement from application authority.
Administrative handoff grants a role and reports still_creator. It does not remove immutable creator authority.
Structural rules precede creator bypass: self-authored join requests, set-once admission policy, invite caps.
Channel votes persist and aggregate per member. Automatic binding of poll outcomes to governance changes is not established.
HKDF derives community-specific pseudonym signing keys. This does not prove resistance to every metadata correlation.
StrongholdKeystore is a legacy name; current backing store is VaultStore.
Secret vault uses SQLCipher page encryption plus per-entry AES-GCM. Do not generalize this to every local cache.
Permissions and slowmode precede encryption; SMPL success triggers best-effort metadata gossip; failed writes queue retry. Delivered here does not prove every peer read it.
Ciphertext binds channel record, member slot and Lamport timestamp as authenticated data.
Notification leads to DHT fetch, verification, decryption, persistence, moderation and UI emission. Gossip is not the message body.
Shared flow handles governance, identity, invite secrets, slot claim and initial presence. Admission policy and bootstrap convenience are separate.
Eight segments with 255 slots give a 2040-member implementation bound, not a verified load benchmark.
UI sends requests and allows recipient acceptance/rejection. Friendship is distinct from DM invitation and voice readiness.
Desktop FriendAccept receive sets Accepted automatically. No third human confirmation is demonstrated in this path. Exact author-intended three-step scope remains unresolved.
Inbox discovery combines watch notifications, polling and manual scan. These three triggers are not three consent steps.
SMPL DM session sends DmInvite through app_call and resolves on accept/decline. Separate from buddy-list Signal messaging.
Community voice implements VoiceJoin, VoiceJoinAck, VoiceJoinConfirmed. Protocol readiness confirmation is not automatically a third human consent click.
The third leg advances local state once and emits connected. Local signaling state alone does not prove remote playback.
Video readiness requires connected handshake, nonempty remote roster, MEK, local capabilities and session config.
Peer confirmation forces a keyframe in native or browser encoder path so a new receiver can begin decoding.
Desktop sender uses Safe routes, the configured anonymity hop floor and LowLatency stability. Configuration is not measured anonymity/latency proof.
Voice changes mesh to MCU at five total participants when a host is available. MCU mixes audio; do not label every media host a blind ciphertext relay.
Video uses 4 KiB payload fragments with separate Reed-Solomon parity. Older 28 KiB video diagrams are stale; comment estimates are not new measurements.
Attachment FEK is wrapped by a matching-generation channel MEK. Delivery still needs retained chunks on available peers.
Nine lifecycle states gate queries, writes, unlock, recovery and shutdown. Detached permits cached reads but can_write is false.
Vault-keyed BLAKE3 chain makes audit history tamper-evident, not immutable against a party holding the key.
Existing property tests check order independence, idempotence, thread and segment convergence, and compaction behavior.

Latest commit republishes media routes in presence and re-announces to present rostered peers lacking reciprocal media. Flowing media prevents stale directory rows from evicting a live peer. These are source-traced repairs, not a fresh live-call result.
MCU decodes peer audio and produces recipient mixes. The peer hosting it is inside the audio plaintext trust boundary; do not portray it as a ciphertext-only forwarding relay.

Current MEK rotation and bootstrap call wrap_mek, which emits legacy X25519/HKDF/AES-GCM wrapping. Authenticated HPKE support exists and unwrap reads both formats; presence of HPKE support does not prove current senders use it.

unresolved: Exact scope of the author's current A-to-B-to-A intent model beyond the verified voice handshake.
Author's democratic/social governance framing versus role authority and binding voting mechanics.
Live two-machine rehearsal of join, media, reconnect and creator-offline behavior.

focused_tests.limits: Existing unit/property/synthetic integration tests only. No live Veilid network or media rehearsal. Synthetic 255-member merge is not a 255-client network load test.

presentation_recommendations: Follow one user action through UI, runtime, pure crate, storage and peer receipt.
Show community origin, invite and join as a journey with named protocol steps.
Distinguish write persistence, notification, receipt and media readiness.
Separate infrastructure equality from authority and consent.
Use the implemented third-leg keyframe effect as technical evidence.
Explain video fragmentation and parity with lost-shard animation, without unverified benchmark numbers.
Show a real architecture failure and the code change that addresses it.
Rehearse every live demo capability and prepare recordings for network-dependent paths.

documentation_reconciliation.current_source: VaultStore with legacy adapter type name
4 KiB payload fragments and Reed-Solomon parity

documentation_reconciliation.older_material: Creation event no longer confers governance authority
documentation_reconciliation.current_source: Separate DHT address key from genesis author pseudonym: latter retains ALL in permission code
Three legs traced through community voice to media readiness and keyframe emission; friendship third human confirmation not established

user_direction.governance: Present the Google deck’s social pressure, democratized voting cycles, decentralized leadership and meaningful ownership as the project’s democratic response to Project 2025. This is a political/design interpretation, not a claim that Project 2025 supplies the model.
user_direction.three_step_intents: Cross-cutting secure control and access principle: A proposes, B accepts, A authorizes completion. Nintendo inspiration is attributed to the project author; do not reduce it to invitations or network handshakes.

nintendo_sources.finding: 3DS friend registration requires reciprocal registration. This supports mutual intent, but does not document a third initiating-user confirmation.

Animal Crossing island transfer separately selects source and target, discovers the counterpart, then requires source Transfer data and target Proceed. Useful precedent for staged intent bound to the discovered target; do not call it an exact A-B-A flow.

political_context_source.finding: February 18, 2025 administration statement requires independent agencies to submit regulations for White House review and consult on priorities, with a monetary-policy exception. Use as concrete context for centralized executive control; frame Rekindle’s response as the author’s values.

code_examples.finding: Incoming reset key material stays pending in memory until user acceptance; supports consent before changing trust state.
Explicit accept_session_reset command. Source tracing does not establish every UI exposes the confirmation correctly.
Administrative roles can be granted and eligible non-creators can relinquish them; creator authority remains immutable. Leadership succession is not abolition of creator power.
Readers validate ordered authored records; convergence assumes the same entry set. Distributed enforcement supports the governance story.

slide_sequence.purpose: Explain voting cycles and social accountability in the author’s terms, grounded in the post–Project 2025 motivation.

accuracy_boundaries: Do not claim an official Nintendo doctrine named three-step intents was found.
Do not describe all current access flows as three manual confirmations.
Do not equate community voting practice with an established automatic election-to-role protocol.
Do not label the author’s stated current governance practice as future merely because it is social rather than automated.

presentation_revision.structure: Preserves the Google deck’s order: Porque, Xfire, Veilid, Tauri, STEAM/Chiral architecture, client/communities/multimedia, three-step intents/governance/identity, lessons, demo, questions.
presentation_revision.visual_direction: Restrained Rekindle palette; Death Stranding discussed within the STEAM section rather than narrating the whole talk.
